name: time-gate
description: Staff clock-in/clock-out tracker. Express serves the API and the built client from one origin.

scripts.build: npm --prefix client ci && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
